name: Tematisk kvalitativ forskningsrapport
description: Svensk tematisk fokusgruppsrapport med deltagarperspektiv, citat, frågor och transkriptbelägg.

sections.title: Återkommande teman
sections.objective: Identify themes recurring across distinct transcript passages and describe their range without treating repetition as consensus.

output_fields.label: Deltagare
output_fields.description: Talare som uttryckte perspektiv inom temat.

output_fields.label: Återkomst
output_fields.description: Antal tydligt separata belägg som stöder temat.

sections.title: Områden av samstämmighet
sections.objective: Summarize explicitly shared viewpoints and distinguish broad agreement from agreement between only some participants.

sections.title: Områden av oenighet
sections.objective: Represent conflicting or divergent participant viewpoints fairly and without inferring personal motives.

sections.title: Deltagarspecifika perspektiv
sections.objective: Summarize each participant's concrete viewpoints using the corrected final speaker assignments and avoid personality judgments.

output_fields.label: Perspektiv
output_fields.description: Sammanfattat perspektiv med stöd i transkriptet.

sections.title: Representativa citat
sections.objective: Select concise verbatim quotations that represent important themes or viewpoints and attribute them to the corrected speaker.

sections.title: Obesvarade frågor
sections.objective: List substantive questions that remained unanswered or underexplored at the end of the focus group.
